prompts.canonical-face:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: canonical transparent PNG face sprite for 타이리 (Tyri), a layered pixel-avatar animation project.
Edit target: the attached green-background approved face image.
Primary request: remove ONLY the bright green background and turn it into genuine fully transparent alpha. Keep exactly the same front-facing floating head: warm golden-orange wavy hair, brown eyes, round golden spectacles, small gold earrings, pale peach skin, subtle smile, and the exact existing chunky pixel-art edges and shading. Preserve the head's facial proportions, expression, colors, orientation and silhouette as closely as possible. Preserve the entire hair and both earrings.
Composition: one centered head only, with generous empty transparent margin on all sides, square PNG. Preserve original canvas and subject position if possible, otherwise output 1536 by 1536 with a single centered head. Do not enlarge the face to fill the canvas.
Constraints: NO hands, no arms, no neck, no shoulders, no torso, no green remnants or green halo, no new objects, no text, no logos, no border, no grid, no painted checkerboard. Transparent pixels must be actual alpha, not a simulated background. This is an isolation edit, not a redesign.
prompts.hands-primary:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production transparent PNG sprite atlas containing ONLY detached hands for 타이리 (Tyri).
Input image 1: approved Tyri face, reference for the pixel-art finish and warm peach skin palette. Input image 2: existing face-and-hand animation sheet, reference for hand anatomy, proportions and gesture style. Do NOT copy any faces or hair into the output.
Primary request: produce a genuine-alpha transparent 1536 by 1536 PNG, arranged as an exact invisible 3-column by 3-row grid. Each cell is 512 by 512; exactly one fully visible detached right hand in each cell. No grid lines or labels. Exactly NINE hands total, no extra objects. Each hand has a short rounded wrist stump, with no arm or sleeve.
Every cell uses the same neutral lighting, same peach palette, same pixel scale, same wrist baseline and same hand size. Use crisp chunky pixel art matching Tyri, discrete pixels, dark reddish-brown outlines, flat warm shading, restrained highlights. Each hand remains inside the central 320 by 360 area of its own 512px cell, with at least 64px empty margin.
Row 1 (top): right-hand wave, palm faces viewer, fingers naturally open. Three successive small waving poses: slight left lean; upright; slight right lean. The thumb is toward screen-right, the side that will point toward the avatar's face when the right hand is placed on screen-left. Keep the wrist anchor at local cell position (256,416).
Row 2 (middle): same right hand making a V sign with index and middle fingers. Three small successive V gesture poses, same wrist anchor and scale, thumb naturally folds across ring and little fingers.
Row 3 (bottom): same right hand making a shushing gesture, index finger up and other fingers curled, suitable to place the fingertip at the lips. Three small successive poses, index mostly vertical, no mouth or face attached.
Invariants: hands only; absolutely NO face pixels, hair, head, glasses, ears, body, skin-colored face patches, background rectangles or shadows cast onto a background. Do not include a duplicate head as a reference thumbnail. Real transparent background/alpha, not a checkerboard illustration.
prompts.hands-secondary:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production transparent PNG sprite atlas containing ONLY detached hands and their held stationery for 타이리 (Tyri).
Input image 1: approved Tyri face, reference for pixel-art rendering and peach skin palette. Input image 2: old hands sheet, gesture reference. Input image 3: writing/thinking sheet, reference for the small spiral notebook, yellow pencil and thinking hand. Do NOT include any faces, heads or hair.
Create a genuine-alpha transparent 1536 by 1536 PNG with an exact invisible 3-column by 3-row grid. Each cell is 512 by 512. Exactly 9 self-contained sprite groups, one in each cell; no grid or text.
Use the same crisp chunky pixel-art style, peach skin color, dark reddish outlines, lighting, scale and fixed placement across all 3 frames in any row. Short detached rounded wrist stumps, no arms or sleeves. Keep all pixels in each cell's central 360 by 360 area, with 64px transparent margins. The animation frames must be tiny pose changes at a common scale, never size changes.
Top row: a PAIR of hands making a heart shape with their thumbs and index fingers. Three consecutive gentle heart-pulse poses, the two-hand group centered at local (256,272), wrists ending near local y=410. Empty transparent heart-shaped center, no head, no heart icon, no decorative sparkle.
Middle row: two hands and a small blank cream-colored top-spiral notebook, with the character's right hand on screen-left holding a yellow pencil and the other hand holding the notebook on screen-right. Three small writing poses. The pencil tip is hidden naturally behind the notebook, as in the reference. Notebook/group size and position identical across the row, centered in each cell. No arm, body or face behind the notebook.
Bottom row: only the character's RIGHT hand for a thinking pose near the temple: index extended diagonally toward upper-right, remaining fingers naturally curled, short wrist at local (240,416). Three small consecutive tapping poses with the same hand/wrist position and scale, fingertip near local (300,130). This sprite will be placed near the avatar's screen-left temple. No head or cheek fragments.
Invariants: ONLY the requested hands/held props in each cell. Absolutely no faces, heads, hair, eyes, glasses, ears or skin face patches. No background or fake transparency checkerboard. Preserve consistent proportions and color across frames.

face_detail_revision.method: Built-in image_gen; one detailed redraw, then the same selected face used in every state
face_detail_revision.reason: The earlier face had coarse pixel clusters and the side-by-side GIF reduced the visible head to approximately 385 pixels wide.
face_detail_revision.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Tyri / 타이리 canonical face sprite, a single transparent PNG for a layered game-avatar renderer.
Input 1 is the primary edit target and identity source: neutral.png. Input 2 is ONLY a rendering-detail reference: 01-wave-01.png. Do not copy Input 2's hand, pose, background, framing, or different face proportions.

Re-create Input 1 as genuinely finer, denser pixel-sprite artwork. This is a detailed redraw, NOT an enlargement of its existing large square pixel blocks. Preserve Tyri's exact recognizable design: front-facing floating head, symmetrical round gold wire-frame glasses, large warm brown eyes, the same tiny closed neutral smile, peach-pink skin, golden-orange center-parted wavy hair with the same outer hair silhouette, and both small gold hoop earrings. Keep the facial proportions, eye spacing, head angle, hair parting, warm restrained palette, and gentle expression from Input 1. Do not age the character or change the identity.

Desired rendering: high-density polished 2D game-sprite pixel art, approaching the finer detail density seen in Input 2. At equivalent displayed head width, use many more smaller pixel steps and much finer linework than Input 1. Refine the iris shading and tiny eye catchlights; make the gold glasses rims thin, coherent and finely stepped; resolve individual flowing hair strands, layered curls and narrow golden highlight bands. Deliberate small pixel clusters with clean, readable shapes, subtle shading and crisp tiny stepped contours. Preserve a pixel-art texture while removing the coarse 10-pixel-like chunky mosaic appearance of Input 1. No bilinear blur, no block enlargement, no vector outlines, no photorealism, no smooth plastic or exaggerated 3D rendering.

Composition: request a large 2048×2048 square canvas. The complete head INCLUDING all hair and both earrings should occupy approximately 80–85% of canvas width, centered, with around 8–10% transparent safety margin. The silhouette must be entirely inside the canvas; do not crop hair or earrings. Only one head, one front view, no duplicates or sprite grid.

Background: real alpha transparency, absolutely no colored backdrop or fake checkerboard. Opaque character interior and clean transparent exterior. No hands, fingers, arms, shoulders, neck, body, chest, props, decorative sparks, lettering, labels, logo, frame or watermark. Preserve the original face's identity and color balance while genuinely redrawing the fine details.
references: Previous assets/sprites/face/neutral.png at the preceding commit
Earlier hand-wave artwork used for fine rendering texture only

visual_review.identity: Front view, warm brown eyes, round gold glasses, golden-orange center-parted wavy hair, neutral closed smile, peach skin, gold hoop earrings retained; generated redraw is not pixel-identical.
visual_review.detail: Visibly finer stepped glasses rims, finer iris shading and catchlights, additional narrow hair highlight bands and smaller stepped hair contours compared with the original coarse sprite.
visual_review.composition: Single head only; no hand, arm, neck, body, text, background, or fake checkerboard.
visual_review.limitations: Actual raster size differs from requested 2048. Silhouette is larger than requested 80-85% width; actual margins and alpha geometry are listed. Some low-alpha pixels extend beyond the meaningful silhouette.

face_detail_revision.note: The source was redrawn with finer detail; this is not a claim of recovering unknown original pixels or producing a native 2048px output.
